remarks: Welcome to 16 Hillside Place, Unit J4 - a stylish townhouse-style condo in the sought-after Victoria Lane community, blending comfort, updates, and thoughtful design across three levels. The entry level offers radiant heated tile floors, a spacious laundry and storage room with built-ins, and direct access to the 1-car garage. A custom drop zone with wainscoting, shiplap, and cubbies makes everyday living organized and easy. Upstairs, the main level features an open and inviting living/dining area filled with natural light, hardwood floors, and crown molding. The updated kitchen shines with quartz counters, stainless steel appliances, crisp cabinetry, subway tile backsplash, and a charming bay window dining nook. A powder room completes this floor. On the top level, find a versatile den/bedroom - previously enclosed as a dedicated bedroom and easily converted back if desired. Whether used as a home office, media room, or guest space, this area provides flexible living options. A stylish full bath with a glass shower and modern finishes, along with a spacious primary suite featuring a large closet with custom organization system, complete this level. Fresh paint, hardwood floors throughout, and turnkey updates make this home move-in ready. Conveniently located near shops, dining, and commuter routes, this townhouse is the perfect blend of modern style and everyday function.
